This is mapped to chemical_or_drug as it involves exogenous nanomaterials. No specific child class in the ontology perfectly fits 'nanoparticle surface coating', so the parent class is used. The proteomics experiment specifically analyzes the proteins adsorbed to these surfaces (the corona).
